stem.text: A man stands stationary in front of a swing. A child sits and swings.

stem.alt: Line drawing of a standing man on the left and a swing frame with a child sitting in the swing on the right. Labels X, Y and Z are printed at three positions: X beside the man, Y under the frame apex, Z beside the swing.

stem.text: The child blows a whistle that emits a sound at a constant frequency.
The man observes the frequency of the sound when the swing is at positions X, Y and Z.
When will the man hear the highest frequency?

A.text: when the swing is at X

B.text: when the swing is at Y and moving away from the man

C.text: when the swing is at Y and moving towards the man

D.text: when the swing is at Z
